fact: ANRPTS, presenting under the Ministry of the Interior at ID4Africa 2025, describes its integrated system SIGPTS as linking the Centres d'Accueil des Citoyens through access gateways to the Registre National Biométrique des Populations, gives 4,973,082 citizens enrolled, and states that the Houwiyeti application was officially launched on 26 December 2023; it gives no count of centres.
title: Agence Nationale du Registre des Populations et des Titres Sécurisés
publisher: Agence Nationale du Registre des Populations et des Titres Sécurisés
